step1_analysis.description: A low-voltage differential amplifier with an auxiliary input pair for offset calibration and a cross-coupled latch, likely used in the tuning or calibration loop of the continuous-time filter.

paper_reference.title: A 0.8-V Accurately Tuned Linear Continuous-Time Filter

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 100uA tail current per stage from 1.8V supply. P = 200uA * 1.8V = 360uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply. The paper used 0.8V supply, so current was higher for the same power.

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the pre-amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. With diode-connected loads, gain is roughly gm_in / gm_load. Expected to be low (10-20 dB) for this specific stage, though the overall filter has higher gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected loads (XM5, XM8) limit the gain of this specific stage.

GBW.description: Unity gain bandwidth of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm / (2 * pi * Cload). With gm ~ 1mS and Cload = 1pF, GBW ~ 150 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The raw OTA bandwidth is much higher than the filter corner frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single-pole dominant response due to diode load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard requirement for stable OTA operation.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, GBW, Phase Margin, and transient swing of the OTA/Comparator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for OTA/Comparator
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N9 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 LABEL_NET_2 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N7 LABEL_NET_3 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N6 N6 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 LABEL_NET_4 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 N7 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N6 LABEL_NET_5 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N8 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 LABEL_NET_6 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N5 N0 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N2 N10 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N0 LABEL_NET_7 N8 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM16 N1 N10 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8

* Inputs with AC and Tran
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5 sin(0.9 0.1 10k)
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5 sin(0.9 -0.1 10k)
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_7 LABEL_NET_7 0 0.9

* Biases and missing connections
VN9 N9 0 1.0
VN10 N10 0 1.0
VN8 N8 0 0

* Load capacitors
C1 N1 0 1p
C2 N2 0 1p
C6 N6 0 1p
C7 N7 0 1p

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = (-i(VVDD) - i(VLABEL_NET_1)) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N6)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N6))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1u 500u
meas tran v_max max v(N6)
meas tran v_min min v(N6)
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

quit
.endc
.end
